description: Relay transport configuration. The transport stores opaque sealed objects only and never decides identity, consent, ordering, retention, delivery policy, or surfacing. No peer private key exists locally; local_key_path refers to this installation's own key.

local_key_path.description: Path to this installation's own relay credential (SSH deploy private key). Never a peer key.

provider.description: Transport provider. Only local and github exist in v0.2.

repo_url.description: Repository URL (github provider) or local path (local provider).

slots.description: Directional relay slots: the local send slot and the local receive slot.

receive_slot.description: Slot name this side reads from.

send_slot.description: Slot name this side writes to.

title: Relay configuration
